source_refs.note: Exercise 4.3, Question 11: book page 77 (PDF 82); answer key PDF 303

blocks.prompt: 11 Decode the message \(\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ 20 \\ 43\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}25 \\ 10 \\ 41\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ 14 \\ 41\end{bmatrix}\) that was encode using matrix \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 1\end{bmatrix}\), where the numbers 1 to 26 are corresponding to the letters \(A\) to \(Z\).
blocks.explanation:
A decoding question: undo the matrix with its inverse.
We must find the hidden words.
Plan: \(|A|\), cofactors, \(A^{-1}\); multiply each coded column by \(A^{-1}\); numbers to letters; check by encoding one column again.
steps:
Given: coded columns \(\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ 20 \\ 43\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}25 \\ 10 \\ 41\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ 14 \\ 41\end{bmatrix}\) and \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 1\end{bmatrix}\); 1 to 26 stand for A to Z.
To find: the original message.
Method: Encoding was \(AX = \text{code}\), so decoding is \(X = A^{-1}(\text{code})\). Find \(A^{-1}\), multiply each coded column, change numbers to letters.

Adjoint and inverse
\[\operatorname{adj}A = \begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 1 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 1 & 1 & -1\end{bmatrix}\]
\[A^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{-1}\operatorname{adj}A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 \\ -1 & -3 & 2 \\ -1 & -1 & 1\end{bmatrix}\]
Why: \(\operatorname{adj}A\) is the transpose of the cofactor matrix; dividing by \(-1\) changes every sign.

Numbers to letters
8 = H, 15 = O, 12 = L, 4 = D, 27 = (space), 6 = F, 9 = I, 18 = R, 5 = E.
Message: HOLD FIRE.
Why: 8 is the 8th letter H, 15 is O, and so on. The number 27 is outside 1 to 26; it can only stand for the gap between the two words (see the Book correction below).

Check by encoding again
\[A\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ 15 \\ 12\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}11 \\ 20 \\ 43\end{bmatrix} \;\checkmark\]
Why: Encoding HOL (8, 15, 12) with \(A\) gives back the first coded column (11, 20, 43).

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Decoding gives 8, 15, 12, 4, 27, 6, 9, 18, 5. The number 27 is not in the printed table (1 to 26 for A to Z); the answer key "Hold Fire" reads 27 as the space between the words without saying so. Also, "was encode" should read "was encoded".
